sensitive_files.reason: Parses and validates untrusted skill-manifest JSON before anything else touches it.
invariants: Untrusted JSON always goes through readManifest() (size limit + nesting-depth check) before JSON.parse — never parsed directly
Ajv instantiated with { strict: true, allErrors: true }

sensitive_files.reason: Resolves the registry path, including the GOODBOY_REGISTRY override, and skill resolution used by every command.
invariants: GOODBOY_REGISTRY must be an absolute path with no path-traversal sequences
All resolved paths are checked with startsWith(base + sep) before use

sensitive_files.reason: Reads/writes registry-entry.json, the versioned record every install/upgrade relies on. Held to 100% coverage as a security-critical file.
invariants: No unvalidated data is written into registry-entry.json
Version/path fields are validated before use in filesystem operations

sensitive_files.reason: Validates an entire skill directory (manifest + SKILL.md + symlink scan) before it's trusted enough to add or install.
invariants: additionalProperties: false enforced on every schema object
Validation runs before any file is copied into the registry or a project

sensitive_files.reason: Reads/writes goodboy.json (user intent) and goodboy.lock (machine-generated state), and is the only place either file is validated against its JSON Schema before any caller consumes it.
invariants: Untrusted goodboy.json/goodboy.lock content only reaches callers through readGoodBoyJson/readGoodBoyLock, which validate against the schemas (Ajv strict + allErrors) — never parsed or blind-cast directly; a same-major file failing validation is rejected (goodboy.json: hard error; goodboy.lock: warn + treated as absent, never partially trusted)

A goodboy.lock declaring a newer-major schema is a hard error, never treated as absent and regenerated — an older CLI must not overwrite a newer tool's output; an older-major or same-major-invalid lock is regenerated on the next write
Skill names are validated against SKILL_NAME_RE before being written or used in a path
The lock never stores an absolute path — the `resolved` field was removed (2026-08-12); installed locations are always recomputed from a validated skill name

sensitive_files.reason: Symlinks installed skills into agent skill directories — each agent maps to a list of paths (~/.claude/skills/, the shared ~/.agents/skills/ convention, ~/.codex/skills/, ~/.gemini/skills/), and shared paths prompt before removal.
invariants: Symlink targets stay within the resolved store/registry path
No symlink is created pointing outside its intended base directory — the traversal guard runs per directory, for every path in every agent's list

A symlink under a path shared by more than one agent is never removed without explicit confirmation; declining aborts the whole removal call with zero side effects — no partial uninstall of one physical skill

sensitive_files.reason: Resolves the global skill store path (~/.goodboy/skills/).
invariants: The assertWithinStore path-traversal guard is preserved on every store path operation

sensitive_files.reason: Defines the canonical SKILL_NAME_RE regex used across the codebase to validate skill names before any filesystem use.
invariants: The regex stays anchored at both ends
No change loosens the character set without an explicit decision

sensitive_files.reason: Implements scanForSymlinks, the guard that rejects a skill directory containing a symlink pointing outside itself before it's added to the registry.
invariants: Every symlink inside a candidate skill directory is resolved and checked against the directory's own boundary before add proceeds

sensitive_files.reason: Computes the SRI content-integrity hash recorded in goodboy.lock at install/upgrade time.
invariants: The hash construction (digest-of-digests) is treated as versioned/frozen — any change is a breaking change to every stored lock hash
Symlinks are hashed by target string, never followed

sensitive_files.reason: Bumps a registry skill's version, including cleanup of an orphaned version directory on a refused bump — the one command file held to the same 100% bar as the lib/ security files.
invariants: A refused or invalid bump never leaves a partially-written version directory behind
Validation runs before any version directory is created

sensitive_files.reason: Recomputes an installed skill's content-integrity hash (via integrity.ts) and classifies it against goodboy.lock — the comparison that gives the recorded hash a meaning. Shared by `goodboy verify` and `goodboy skill status`.
invariants: Never treats a missing/absent integrity field as a match — classified as its own not-verified state, never silently folded into verified
Never recomputes or reinterprets the hash construction itself — that stays owned by integrity.ts

sensitive_files.reason: The `goodboy verify` command — the fail-closed gate on top of verify.ts's classification. Held to the same 100% bar as the lib/ security files.
invariants: Exits non-zero if any checked skill is in the mismatch state; a not-verified skill never affects the exit code
A named skill that isn't installed produces a clear error, never a false verified/mismatch result

sensitive_files.reason: Displays installed-skill drift, now via the same whole-tree integrity comparison verify.ts performs (previously only diffed SKILL.md, which could miss tampering in any other file). Informational only — no exit-code gate — but a false "up to date"/"modified" here is the same class of false confidence as a wrong goodboy verify result, so it's held to the same 100% bar.
invariants: A not-verified skill is rendered distinctly from both "up to date" and "modified" — never folded into either
A skill whose manifest is present but unparseable is rendered as "unreadable", never as "not installed" — an unknown state is never reported as a known one, in either direction
The integrity check is not run for a skill whose manifest could not be parsed — there is no trustworthy version to compare, so no drift verdict is emitted

sensitive_files.reason: Spawns $EDITOR (or an autodetected editor) as a subprocess — the one place GoodBoy launches an external process.
invariants: Never uses shell: true
Only ever passes the resolved SKILL.md path as an argument, never a shell string

sensitive_files.reason: Takes a user-supplied path argument and copies its directory contents into the registry — the primary entry point where third-party skill content first reaches persistent storage.
invariants: isRemoteRefArgument() rejects a URL-shaped or scp-style argument before resolve() is ever called on it
scanForSymlinks() runs on the skill directory before any cpSync of its contents

The directory name (basename of the resolved path) is validated against SKILL_NAME_RE before being used to construct any registry path — and a manifest-declared name is required to exactly match that already-validated directory name before it is used instead

sensitive_files.reason: Takes a user-supplied path argument and a third-party SKILL.md with no manifest.json, parses its untrusted frontmatter to synthesise a manifest, and copies the source directory into a new local directory.
invariants: isRemoteRefArgument() rejects a URL-shaped or scp-style argument before resolve() is ever called on it
scanForSymlinks() runs on the source directory before any cpSync of its contents
The frontmatter-declared name is validated against SKILL_NAME_RE before being used to construct the target directory path
MAX_SKILL_MD_BYTES (mirroring manifest.ts's size ceiling) is not raised without an explicit decision
An existing target directory is never overwritten — existsSync(targetDir) is checked and rejected before any cpSync

sensitive_files.reason: Every message the CLI ever prints (info/success/warn/error, plus sanitiseError()) passes through here — the point where caller-provided strings, including untrusted content like SKILL.md frontmatter, become terminal output.
invariants: Every message passed to info/success/warn/error has control characters and DEL stripped before being written — no caller-provided string reaches stdout/stderr with raw control bytes intact

sensitive_files.reason: The JSON Schema used to validate every manifest.
invariants: additionalProperties: false on every object definition
Adding additionalProperties: true anywhere is treated as a breaking security change
